title: Leamas Closure Plan v1 Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema declaring the Leamas Closure Plan v1 dialect and required vocabularies. The Closure Plan v1 schema resource resolves to this meta-schema through $schema. Implementations MUST understand all listed required vocabularies to validate a Closure Plan v1 document. See ACT-LEAMAS-FACTORY-CLOSE-PLAN-V1-RUN-EXECUTION-FIELDS-CONTRACT-PARITY01-CORRECTION05.

leamas-extension-keywords.description: Normative Leamas Closure Plan v1 extension keywords.

sibling.description: JSON name of the sibling field whose value activates the rule.

value.description: Literal sibling value that activates the rule.

presence.description: Required/forbidden outcome when the sibling matches.

allow_dot.description: Closure Plan v1 invariant: only the literal '.' path is allowed when allow_dot is true.

allow_parent_segments.description: Closure Plan v1 invariant: parent traversal segments are always rejected.

require_lexically_clean.description: Closure Plan v1 invariant: paths must equal their canonical clean form.

separator.description: Closure Plan v1 invariant: the only structural path separator is '/'.
